name: Message Subscribe
description: Subscribe API for the Message and Message notify modules.
project_description:
Overview 
 With this module, users who subscribe to content will be notified when events that involve that content occur. The module leverages the Flag module, which provides a subscribe functionality to users.

 Message Subscribe is part of the message stack , a suite of modules that provide a framework for messaging and notifications.

 The other modules in the message stack are:

 Message – define message types and generate messages

 Message Notify – forward messages when they are generated

 Features 
 
 Subscribe to events related to content, users, etc. 
 Multilingual support 
 API Hooks 
 Example module 
 Bulk notification of subscribers 
 
 Requirements 
 Message 

 Message Notify 

 Flag 

 Entity API 

 Chaos tool suite (ctools) 

 Documentation 
 See the message stack handbook.
